name: zcode-context
description: 只读查看会话用量、模型输入组成、请求差异和压缩事件。装好后点右上角「切换面板」，在会话侧边栏打开「上下文」面板；建议同时在「设置 → 通用」打开「完整保留模型 I/O」——默认记录会丢弃更早的请求，且无法事后恢复。

description_i18n.en: Read-only session usage, model input composition, request differences and compaction events. After installing, open the Context panel from the session sidebar (top-right panel switcher); also turn on full Model I/O retention in Settings → General — the default recording drops older requests and cannot recover them later.
